name: Claims Operations Center
challenge: First notice of loss takes hours: policy checks, fraud screening and a fair payout estimate.
does: Reads the claim and pulls cover, deductible and status from the policy database
A three-member fraud panel runs in parallel
High fraud score → SIU referral note, and the flow stops
governance: Payout drafts carry evidence; fraud referrals stop automation

name: Hospital Care Coordination
challenge: Emergency departments must triage fast, find a bed, hand over cleanly and write discharge summaries.
does: Extracts key facts from the ER note into a structured summary
Scores urgency; urgent cases get a live bed and a referral draft
Drafts discharge summaries for clinician sign-off
governance: Every score below threshold goes to the duty clinician

name: Bank Credit & Onboarding
challenge: Loan and KYC decisions need bureau data, affordability maths and sanctions screening, all explainable.
does: Pulls the bureau record and computes EMI and debt-to-income
Credit, risk and policy analysts review in parallel
Credit committee scores the case and writes a decision memo
governance: Gender and religion forbidden; low confidence → a person

name: University Admissions & OBE
challenge: Admissions must be merit-based and fair, and every course needs NBA/NAAC outcome-based evidence.
does: Checks seats and merit cut-offs for the programme
Academic, statement and potential reviewers assess in parallel
Panel scores the case and drafts the letter; CO-PO attainment for OBE
governance: Caste, gender, religion, nationality, income: forbidden inputs

name: SOC Incident Command
challenge: Security operations centres drown in alerts; analysts need assets, owners and threat intel at once.
does: Enriches alerts from the CMDB and checks every IP and domain against threat intel
Splits the batch and scores severity in parallel
Severe → IT operations runbook; post-quantum readiness scan
governance: Untrusted intel fenced against prompt injection

name: Supply Chain Control Tower
challenge: Customs holds, breakdowns and damage need a quick view of where stock is and what to do next.
does: Tracks the shipment and checks stock cover in parallel
Scores how critical the exception is
Critical → impact, alternatives, costs and a recovery plan
governance: Quantum route options verified before they are proposed

name: Citizen Services Desk
challenge: Complaints must reach the right department fast; urgent ones (health, safety, children) first.
does: Finds ward, department, desk and service-level target
Urgent → priority cell with an action plan
Checks every reply for clarity; welfare eligibility pre-check
governance: AI disclosure on every reply; eligibility decided by people

name: Legal Contract Desk
challenge: In-house legal teams review dozens of NDAs and contracts a week against the same playbook.
does: Extracts NDA terms and scores deviation from the playbook
Suggests redlines with approved fallback wording
Analyses every contract clause in parallel and summarises for counsel
governance: Counsel decides; the desk drafts with cited clauses

name: Algo Trading Desk (QuantOracle™)
challenge: A trading desk must decide which strategies are robust enough to trade, within risk and conduct rules.
does: Quant, compliance and editorial reviewers run in parallel
Robustness is an uncertain<score> sampled five times
Failing backtests (PF < 1.3 or DD > 15%) are rejected by a guard
governance: Approval only for PAPER trading, through the review queue

name: Quantum Optimization Lab
challenge: Many business decisions are combinatorial: which k of n assets to hold, which jobs go on which shift.
does: Portfolio selection as a QUBO, solved with QAOA
Max-cut, scheduling and certified quantum randomness
Every answer checked against the exact classical optimum
governance: Guard on VERIFIED / GAP; max qubits enforced by policy

name: AlgoQ Quantum AI Lab™
challenge: Quantum computers are noisy, scarce and expensive, and their answers are distributions, not facts.
does: VQE ground-state energies, checked by exact diagonalisation
Knapsack capital budgeting and spectrum colouring with QAOA
Quantum kernels cross-validated against a classical RBF
governance: QPU budgets; only VERIFIED answers reach a two-approval committee

name: AlgoGraph™ LLM & SLM Optimizer
challenge: Large models are slow and costly; small models are cheap but not always good enough.
does: Reads each program's agent graph from the compiler
Picks the cheapest LLM or SLM per agent that meets quality and latency
Proves the choice optimal; routes live traffic small-model-first
governance: Route decided in code, not by a model

name: AlgoML Model Factory™
challenge: Shipping a model safely needs more than a high score: fair comparison, calibration and drift checks.
does: Trains three model families in parallel with 5-fold cross-validation
Picks a calibrated champion (ECE ≤ 0.05)
Catches target leakage before training; monitors drift
governance: A leaking column stops the run before any training

name: AlgoRL Control Room™
challenge: An RL controller can beat a hand-written rule, but a grid cannot afford trial-and-error mistakes.
does: Q-learning for a 2 MWh campus battery over 3,000 simulated days
Safety shield enforces the 1.75 MW grid-import cap
Benchmarked against the exact optimum, then heatwave stress tests
governance: Policy deploys only after it beats the rule and stays safe

name: AlgoXAI Audit Studio™
challenge: A credit model can be accurate and still unfair, often through a feature that stands in for a protected one.
does: Exact Shapley values over all 2⁶ coalitions
Fairness audit on a group used only for auditing
Actionable recourse: the smallest change that flips a decline
governance: Age and area are never suggested as changes

name: AlgoNLP Document Intelligence™
challenge: A bank receives thousands of messages a week: card blocks, loans, KYC updates, fraud reports.
does: Classifies, extracts entities and summarises every message in parallel
Emerging topics and distinctive words per category
Reply drafts routed to the right queue
governance: Fraud reports always go to a person, with evidence

name: AlgoBharat Bhasha Desk™
challenge: Citizens write in their own language and script: Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Bengali and more.
does: Detects the language from 11 scripts; separates Hindi from Marathi
Transliterates Brahmic scripts (ISO 15919 style)
Finds the need (pension, ration, water…) and replies in kind
governance: Coverage reported honestly; unknown scripts go to a person

name: AlgoCare Remote Monitoring™
challenge: Thousands of patients are monitored at home; their readings must be triaged safely, around the clock.
does: Scores every reading with NEWS2, exactly by published bands
Checks the record and major drug interactions in parallel
High → emergency alert; medium → review within the hour
governance: A clinician reviews every alert

name: AlgoBio Network Lab™
challenge: Disease genes cluster in the protein network, so known proteins can point to new candidates.
does: Analyses a 1,500-protein, 7,441-interaction network in parallel
Random walk with restart, validated on hidden disease proteins
Negative control from random seeds; enrichment and sequences
governance: A weak control is required before results are reported

name: AlgoEng Predictive Maintenance™
challenge: Unplanned pump failures stop production and can be dangerous; the data shows them coming.
does: Vibration diagnosis by ISO zones, in parallel with prognosis
Remaining useful life with a 90% interval
Fleet scan and a maintenance plan
governance: Urgent work orders are approved by a person

name: AlgoCity Operations Centre™
challenge: A city control room sees air, waste and electricity data around the clock, each in its own silo.
does: Checks AQI (CPCB), waste routes and energy load in parallel
Very poor AQI → multilingual health advisory
Overload risk → load plan; never hospitals, water or signals
governance: Advisories need the duty officer; load plans need two officers

name: AlgoMove Transport Network Optimizer™
challenge: When an arterial road closes, traffic floods side streets within minutes; fixed signals cannot cope.
does: Reroutes traffic (Dijkstra) and retimes signals (Webster) in parallel
Gravity-model demand and transit headways
Oversaturated junctions → police control and metering plan
governance: Control-room officer approves; notices carry AI disclosure
